issues.legal_issue: A trustee who holds land for both the trustee’s own benefit and the benefit of beneficiaries is assessable on the total agricultural income as a holder for mixed benefit rather than as a representative manager for jointly interested persons.
material_facts: A deed transferred agricultural properties to trustees and vested the properties in them to hold under a trust.
The deed directed the managing trustee to manage the properties and distribute their income among the trustees and other beneficiaries.
The managing trustee was assessed on the total agricultural income from the trust properties.

The trustees held the properties for their own benefit as well as for the benefit of others, and were not receivers, administrators, or common managers appointed by law or agreement on behalf of persons jointly interested.
issues.conclusion: The assessment was properly made on the managing trustee under the provision governing a holder of land for the holder’s own benefit and the benefit of beneficiaries, not under the provision for specified representative managers and similar persons.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 12 and 13 of the Assam Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1939, section 13 is subject to section 12. The word “holds” in both sections includes holding by title as well as possession. Section 13 applies to a common manager appointed by law or agreement, or a receiver, administrator, or like person, holding on behalf of persons jointly interested; it does not apply to a person holding land partly for that person’s own benefit and partly for others. A trustee in whom the property is vested and who holds it for mixed benefit falls within section 12. The judgment relies on no earlier cases.

rule.if: agricultural_income_tax_assessment and land_held_for_holder_and_beneficiaries and (trustee_holds_vested_land or holder_has_title_or_possession) and not (qualifying_common_manager_for_joint_interests or receiver_or_equivalent_for_joint_interests)

predicates.agricultural_income_tax_assessment: The proceeding assesses a person for tax on agricultural income from land.
predicates.land_held_for_holder_and_beneficiaries: The holder holds land partly for the holder’s own benefit and partly for the benefit of beneficiaries.
predicates.trustee_holds_vested_land: The holder is a trustee in whom the land is vested.
predicates.holder_has_title_or_possession: The holder has legal title to or possession of the land.
predicates.qualifying_common_manager_for_joint_inte: The holder is a common manager appointed by law or agreement to hold land on behalf of persons jointly interested in it or its income.
predicates.receiver_or_equivalent_for_joint_interes: The holder is a receiver, administrator, or similar person holding land on behalf of persons jointly interested in it or its income.

issues.definition: When an agricultural-income assessment concerns land held for both the holder and beneficiaries, and the holder is not acting as a qualifying common manager or receiver-like representative for jointly interested persons, the holder is assessed as if the land were held exclusively for the holder.
